{{Otheruses|tooth}}
[[File:ShaakTiCloseup-SWBC60.png|thumb|right|250px|Shaak Ti's headdress]]
An '''Akul-tooth headdress''' was a type of headdress worn by [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]].

==Description==
The headdress was worn on the forehead and glued on the head and extended around the [[Eye/Legends|eye]] patches of the Togruta. The headdress incorporated [[Pearl/Legends|pearls]], metals, and stones, along with the [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] of [[Akul/Legends|akul]].<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==History==
The headdress was sported by [[Gender/Legends|males]] and [[Gender/Legends|females]] who had slain an akul by themselves. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were known for wearing their headdress with their [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]].
